## About adwali | Digital Marketing Agency in Jaipur
URL: https://www.adwali.com/about/

# The adwali baat.
We're a full-service digital marketing agency out of Jaipur, built for brands that refuse to stay quiet. We mix strategy, creativity, and a lot of hustle to get our clients found, seen, and chosen. Har brand ki adwali baat.
## Marketing that actually moves the needle.
adwali started with a simple frustration: too many agencies were great at sending reports full of numbers that looked impressive and meant nothing. Impressions, reach, vanity metrics. Meanwhile the client's actual sales weren't moving.
So we built the opposite. An agency obsessed with the numbers that pay the bills: leads, sales, revenue, rankings that bring real buyers. Everything we do ties back to growth you can actually feel.
Today we're a full-service team covering SEO, ads, social, content, web, branding, video, and more, working with brands across 80+ industries. One team, one obsession: making our clients grow.
## Shubham Sharma
Shubham started adwali with a clear belief: marketing should be judged by results, not activity. After years of watching brands pour money into marketing that didn't move the needle, he set out to build an agency that does things differently.
His approach is hands-on and honest. No overpromising, no hiding behind jargon, just a sharp team, a clear plan, and relentless focus on getting clients real growth. Under his lead, adwali has grown into a full-service team trusted by brands across the country.
"We don't want to be another agency you forget about. We want to be the reason your brand finally takes off."
## How we work.
We chase revenue, leads, and rankings, not likes that look nice but pay nothing.
No jargon, no smoke. We tell you what is working, what is not, and what it costs.
Every idea has a job to do. Pretty is not enough; it has to work.
We treat your brand like it is ours, because half-caring gets half-results.
We build brands and rankings that last, not shortcuts that fall apart later.
SEO, ads, content, design, all talking to each other, so nothing works in isolation.
## What clients say.
"adwali turned our online presence around completely. We're getting more quality leads than ever, and they actually explain what they're doing and why."
"The team just gets results. Our traffic and sales are both up, and they're honestly easy to work with. Best marketing partner we've had."
"Professional, responsive, and they treat our brand like it's their own. Working with adwali has been the best marketing decision we've made."

Brand Name GeneratorSpin up brandable, available-sounding name ideas in seconds.
## Why we're building these
Good marketing decisions start with good information, and most small teams don't have the budget for a stack of paid tools just to answer simple questions. How's my page doing on SEO? What should my ad budget be? Is this headline any good? You shouldn't need a subscription to find out.
So we're putting the checks we run internally into simple, free tools anyone can use. No account, no credit card, no email wall. Just open the tool, get your answer, and get on with your day. They're built for founders, marketers, and small business owners in Jaipur and across India who want clear answers without the fluff.

Each tool does one job and does it well. You'll get a quick result you can actually act on, plus a short explanation of what it means and what to do next. No vanity scores, no jargon. If a tool tells you something's wrong, it'll also tell you how to fix it, or point you to someone who can.

## Paid Media Case Study: Lower CPL | adwali
URL: https://www.adwali.com/case-paid/

# Cutting cost-per-lead in half.
How we turned a leaky ad account into a lead machine, and made every rupee of budget work harder.
## A B2B SaaS company burning budget on ads that were not converting.
This software company was spending a healthy budget on paid ads but getting expensive, low-quality leads. The account was a tangle of broad targeting, weak landing pages, and no clear tracking of what was actually working.
The challenge: cost per lead was climbing, the leads that did come in rarely converted, and nobody could see where the budget was going.
## We rebuilt the account around qualified leads.
We restructured the campaigns from scratch, tightened the targeting to reach the right decision-makers, and rewrote the ad copy to speak to their real pain points. We also built dedicated landing pages focused on a single action.
Then we set up proper conversion tracking so we could see exactly what was driving qualified leads, cut what was not working, and pour budget into what was. We tested relentlessly and optimised every week.
## What happened.
“They took an account that was bleeding money and turned it around fast. We are now getting better leads for half the cost, and we can actually see what is working.”

## SEO Case Study: 5x Organic Traffic | adwali
URL: https://www.adwali.com/case-seo/

# From page three to the top.
How we took an online store from invisible to the top of Google, and quadrupled its sales in the process.
## A Jaipur e-commerce brand with great products and no traffic.
This online store had a solid catalogue and happy customers, but almost nobody was finding it through search. Their pages sat on page three and beyond for the terms that mattered, so they were leaning entirely on paid ads to make sales.
The challenge: rankings were nowhere, the site had serious technical issues, and every sale was being rented from ads rather than earned from search.
## We rebuilt their SEO from the ground up.
We started with a full technical audit, fixing site speed, crawl issues, and a messy structure that was holding everything back. Then we optimised every category and product page around the terms their buyers were actually searching for.
Alongside that, we built genuine authority through content and quality backlinks, and set up the internal linking to spread that authority across the store. Then we tracked, refined, and kept climbing.
## What happened.
“We went from basically invisible on Google to the top of the results for our main products. Organic is now our biggest sales channel, and we spend far less on ads.”

## Video Case Study: A Viral Reel | adwali
URL: https://www.adwali.com/case-video/

# A reel that went everywhere.
How we made short-form video for a consumer brand that broke out and pulled in a whole new audience.
## A consumer food brand that wanted reach.
This brand wanted to grow its audience fast but its content was not landing. Their videos were polished but felt like ads, so they got scrolled past. They needed content built for how people actually watch and share on social.
The challenge: low reach, content that felt like advertising, and no traction on the short-form formats where the audience actually was.
## We made video built for the feed.
We shifted the approach from polished ads to authentic, hook-first short-form video designed for how people really scroll. We led with a strong opening, kept it punchy, and built each piece around a reason to watch and share.
We produced content in batches so the brand could post consistently, rode the formats and trends that were working, and doubled down the moment something started to take off. One reel broke out and pulled the rest up with it.
## What happened.
“One reel completely changed our reach. They understood how short-form actually works, and it showed. We gained more audience in a month than in the year before.”

## Web Design Case Study: CRO Wins | adwali
URL: https://www.adwali.com/case-web/

# A site that finally converts.
How we turned a good-looking website that nobody acted on into one built to turn visitors into enquiries.
## A professional services firm with a pretty site and few leads.
This firm had invested in a website that looked the part but generated almost no enquiries. Visitors landed, looked around, and left without ever getting in touch. The design was fine; the experience was not built to convert.
The challenge: high traffic but a high bounce rate, a confusing user journey, and no clear path from visitor to enquiry.
## We redesigned it around one thing: conversion.
We mapped how visitors actually moved through the site and found where they were dropping off. Then we redesigned the key pages around a clear, obvious path to getting in touch, with sharper messaging and stronger calls to action.
We simplified the journey, cut the friction, and made the next step obvious on every page. Then we tested variations to keep lifting the conversion rate over time.
## What happened.
“Our old site looked nice but did nothing. The new one actually brings in enquiries. Same traffic, completely different results.”

## What clients say.
